youtube.title: 🔥 This AI Search Engine Knows What Google Can't Find
youtube.description:
Ever Google someone before a meeting and only find their LinkedIn from 2023? You're missing the real story.

The /last30days repo (46K+ stars) is an AI agent that searches Reddit upvotes, X posts, YouTube transcripts, TikTok engagement, Hacker News threads, and Polymarket odds—all in parallel. It scores results by what real people actually engage with, not by editors or SEO ranking.

Run /last30days on a person's name and get their last 30 days: tweets, Reddit threads, GitHub PRs, YouTube appearances, and prediction market odds. Before your next investor pitch or sales call, you'll know exactly what they're working on right now.

It bridges platforms no single AI can access alone. ChatGPT has Reddit but not X. Gemini has YouTube but not Reddit. Claude has none of them natively. But bring your own API keys and this agent searches everything at once, then synthesizes one grounded brief.

MIT licensed, Python, zero config for Reddit and Hacker News. 30-second setup wizard unlocks X, YouTube, TikTok. Even exports shareable HTML briefs for Slack.

Link in bio to the repo. If you research people or topics before meetings, this changes everything.

linkedin.text:
I used to Google people before meetings. Outdated LinkedIn profiles. Blog posts from 2022. Nothing about what they're actually working on right now.

Last week I found a repo that changed how I prepare.

It's called /last30days, and it's an AI agent that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, and Polymarket simultaneously. Not keywords. Real upvotes, real likes, real money backing predictions.

46,000+ GitHub stars because you literally cannot get this search anywhere else.

I ran it on a CEO I'm meeting tomorrow. Got their last 23 GitHub PRs, their viral tweet thread from 3 days ago, the Reddit debate about their product (569 upvotes), and Polymarket odds on their company's next move.

None of that was on Google.

The genius is it bridges platforms no single AI can access. ChatGPT can't search X. Gemini can't search Reddit threads. Claude has none of them natively. Each platform is a walled garden with different APIs and auth.

But bring your own keys and this agent searches them all at once, scores by engagement, and synthesizes one brief. Even exports HTML you can share in Slack.

I've used it before investor calls, competitor research, and trip planning. It's not just better search. It's a fundamentally different way to understand what's actually happening.

MIT licensed. Python. Zero config for Reddit/HN, 30-second setup for the rest.

Repo link in the comments. If you research people or markets, you need this.
